nom: The INKEY List Starter Retinol Serum for Fine lines + Wrinkles

segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive report no irritation, stinging, or redness, several calling it the first retinol that hasn't burned or reacted badly with their skin; a couple of reviewers who say they normally react to retinol, however, still eventually broke out or became irritated after several uses.
segments.dry: The one reviewer who describes her skin as both sensitive and dry reports it worked perfectly, with no extra dryness or flaking and no irritation.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother, more even skin texture and visibly softer fine lines, particularly around the forehead and mouth, sometimes within one to two weeks; a couple of reviewers note results are gradual rather than dramatic and that those with deep wrinkles or more experience with retinol may eventually need a stronger formula.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report no dryness or flaking, several crediting the added squalane with keeping skin hydrated instead of dried out; a handful, however, do report some dryness, in one case tied to using too much product and resolving once she used less.
concerns.redness: Reviewers who mention redness consistently report none, including some who say other actives normally leave their skin red; no reviewer in this set reports increased redness.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fading blemishes or smoother skin in areas where they usually get small bumps; a couple of reviewers, including some who say they always react badly to retinol, report breakouts or irritation that made them stop, and one reviewer describes a temporary purge of breakouts that resolved after a couple of weeks.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report dark spots or hyperpigmentation looking less visible after as little as one to two uses.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes she saw more oil on her face while using the serum, though she says her skin still felt smooth; this isn't mentioned by other reviewers.

aspects.libelle: Mild strength, less suited to experienced users

extraits.texte: This retinol didn't work out for me in the long run as I eventually broke out but it would be great for anyone who isn't sensitive to retinol. It doesn't have a scent and soaks into the skin as soon as you apply it.

I was excited at the idea of trying a beginner retinol as I have never had luck with them and always experience irritation and breakouts. I had high hopes for this one but alas it didn't work out for me either. I will say this definitely is gentle, because I didn't experience irritation until the 5 or 6 usage! I started out using twice weekly then went to once a week but still experienced irritation so it's sadly not for me. But I definitely would recommend trying! Maybe your experience will be better.

I used to be pretty skeptical about retinol, but after weighing all the pros and cons, I finally decided to give this serum a try. I apply it every other night, and I've been pleasantly surprised. The texture feels great on the skin, and there's absolutely no discomfort, no burning, no peeling, no redness.What I did notice, though, was a real improvement in my skin's appearance. Fine lines started to smooth out, and my skin looks more elastic and youthful. The only downside I experienced was a few breakouts, but I've read that this is a normal and common reaction when your pores start to purge and your skin begins a faster regeneration process. And honestly, after a couple of weeks, the breakouts started to disappear.So yes, there might be a few temporary inconveniences, but if the result is glowing, smoother, younger-looking skin, it's absolutely worth it.

I've been using The INKEY List Retinol Serum every day for the last three weeks, and it's been a fantastic experience for my sensitive skin. The creamy texture sinks in beautifully, and I was pleasantly surprised to experience no initial irritation, even with nightly use. While it's too early to see major changes, my skin is already noticeably glowing. I did have a bit of dryness, but I've been able to combat it by switching from my usual gel to a cream moisturizer. I'm really keen to see if this "advanced" formula delivers faster results than standard retinol; so far, it's a very promising and gentle start!

extraits.titre: Hyperpigmentation is already looking less visible
extraits.texte: I have used this product twice so far. I believe you can see in these pictures that my hyperpigmentation is already looking less visible. The first time, I believe, I used too much and I experienced a little bit of dry skin. The second time, using the correct amount, I had no issues. After already noticing the results, I am so excited to continue to use this product.

extraits.titre: Great way to start a Retinol
extraits.texte: This is a great way to start a Retinol treatment. This did not cause any irritation or dryness, and I do have fairly sensitive skin. I think Retinol is a great skincare product for me heading into my 30s where I'm not ready for Botox but I am noticing some signs of aging. Overall, would highly recommend this product, and for the price point, you can't beat it!

I have sensitive and dry skin but this retinol worked perfectly for me. I noticed a difference almost right away in skin texture. At the same time my skin was not any more dry or flakey and I noticed no irritation. complimentary from theinkeylist
